name: Larentia ~Netsujou no Miyako~
original_name: ラレンティア ～熱情の都～
source:
Julius is an aspiring adventurer visiting port city of Genoa in Larentia region. The city is prospering and thus there is a constant shortage of manpower. Julius answers the call to make a name for himself over three years.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Julius是一名立志成为冒险者的青年，来到Larentia地区的港口城市Genoa。城市繁荣兴盛，因此人手始终短缺。Julius响应招募，希望在接下来的三年里闯出名声。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
